title: RELATED cannot go from the one side to the many side

expected.error: Product is on the one side of its relationship with Sales: RELATED ( Sales[Amount] ) has no single related row to read

source.quote: RELATED works from the many-side of a relationship towards the one-side
source.supports: RELATED only works from the many side towards the one side; the other direction needs RELATEDTABLE

source.quote: the function follows a chain of one or more many-to-one relationships to fetch the value from the specified column in the related table

derivation: The row context is on Product, the one side of Sales[ProductKey] -> Product[ProductKey]. Sales is not reachable from Product through many-to-one relationships, so Sales[Amount] is not a column of Product's expanded table and RELATED cannot return a single value: an error.
